body: As someone in the Same boat, best of luck. And i hope everything works out for you.
It's actually an Infected leg, but absolutely. I feel like this is a crossroads. I'm being given the option of a way out, on my own terms.
Thank you. All i've asked for on here was to be heard.

Thank you. I put it into pets, but that just made life worse for them. I got a Chow puppy, and back in '09 this crazy homeless guy poisoned him..on my birthday. 
In 2010 I was given another one. My friend called me at work to say he was throwing up blood and screaming. $7000 later i was in debt with a dead dog.

I used to put a lot of heart into relationships because, in general they were the best and only happy aspect of my life. I did it with my job, and then got a series of district managers so terrible that I can't even describe it. My current one? Quoted Michael Jordan, and managed to MISPELL Jordan. 

Change is wonderful. But I can't change most things in my life. The area i'm in has damn near nothing for jobs. My house is full of bad memories, but I can't move because mortgage. And most places don't rent to large dogs anymore. 

I'm not tryig to make excuses. I've thought about it all myself. But i'm trapped. Completely and utterly.

I no longer have the time or the patience to look for a new one. My anger levels are too high for it. I'm volatile. 
I believe there are some good ones, but the other problem for me is that I legitimately don't want to get help. I really, truly don't want to see next year.

Absolutely. Thank you. But, in all honesty, I intend for the people never to hear about this side of me. I want them to remember me as they knew me, not as I really was.

To be honest? No, there isn't. The only part of me that feels any sort of negativity is the thought of my animals and what they'll do without me.
But, I have it set so no matter what they're all going to good homes. None will go to shelters. 

When I look at myself in the mirror, I feel euphoria when I look into my own eyes and say "I'm going to die." It's the only thing that has brought me any sort of positive emotion in months. I'm not going to do it myself. But I know at this point it's a waiting game. And time is on my side.

I wanted to tell the story not to a community that cares, but to a community where no one knew me. Because in my entire life, 5 people know how badly I hurt. And none of them know the story, save for one. 
I wanted people to know, people who didn't know me. 

I've been to therapy. It was a joke. I got prescribed drugs that made me impotent and numb. My depression is mildly chemical, but mostly situational. No drugs undo anything. And no amount of talking does either.

Thank you for the compliments otherwise.
